entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker whose brother's murder ignited his spark; he searches for the killer and carries a double-bladed axe.

entities.name: Ajani's brother
entities.description: The charismatic leonin leader of Ajani's pride, found murdered.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A blue planeswalker gifted with reading and destroying memories and driven by a longing for knowledge.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who made a deal with demons for a young body and incredible power.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who scours the multiverse for fire spells.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter with green mana and an uncanny understanding of animals.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Creatures from abyssal hell-dimensions to whom Liliana is in debt.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Plane inspired by British Isles folklore, with faeries and kithkin and no humans, where the five planeswalkers premiered.

entities.name: Kephalai
entities.description: A plane where Chandra handled authority figures with boom spells.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who made great sacrifices to heal the rift damage in the Time Spiral storyline.

events.summary: Ajani found his brother murdered; the pride collapsed and some blamed Ajani.
The pain and shock ignited Ajani's spark and he was immediately planeswalked away.
events.quote: The pain and shock ignited Ajani's spark.

events.summary: Ajani recovers and vows to find the killer and reunite the scattered pride, carrying an axe fused with his brother's.
events.quote: To this day he searches for answers, carrying with him a double-bladed axe

events.summary: Liliana made a deal with demons, gaining a young woman's body for a long time and great power.
events.quote: Liliana made a deal with some demons, and now she's got the bod and vigor of a young woman for a long, long time.

events.summary: Chandra, on Kephalai, handled authority figures with boom spells.
events.quote: Like that time on Kephalai, she'll prove she can handle those bozos just fine with the clever application of boom spells.

relations.note: Led Ajani's pride (the pride, not Ajani only)
relations.quote: a fierce and charismatic leonin who eventually became leader of their pride
Ajani's brother, however, always saw him as an inspiration

relations.note: In the debt of demons after a pact
relations.quote: Liliana is in the debt of demons, and they aren't known for being forgiving creditors.
